row.name: employees_user_uq
row.where: user_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

row.name: attendances_times_check
row.value: check_out_at IS NULL OR check_in_at IS NULL OR check_out_at >= check_in_at

row.name: employee_salaries_range_check
row.value: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

row.name: employee_salary_records_amounts_check
row.value: base_salary >= 0 AND allowances >= 0 AND overtime_pay >= 0 AND bonus >= 0 AND deductions >= 0

row.name: employee_salary_records_net_check
row.value: net_pay = base_salary + allowances + overtime_pay + bonus - deductions

row.name: employees_termination_check
row.value: termination_date IS NULL OR hire_date IS NULL OR termination_date >= hire_date

row.name: human_resource_code_numberings_reset_check
row.value: reset_policy IS NULL OR reset_policy IN ('never', 'yearly', 'monthly')

row.name: schedules_shift_check
row.value: (is_day_off AND shift_start IS NULL AND shift_end IS NULL) OR (NOT is_day_off AND shift_start IS NOT NULL AND shift_end IS NOT NULL)
